# A&A Choclates

> A&A Choclates is a boutique artisanal chocolate studio in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, crafting hand-made premium chocolates, curated gifting hampers, and custom celebration treats with care.

## About
- Brand: A&A Choclates (tagline: "CRAFT WITH CARE")
- Founder: Niquehat Khan
- Location: MIG A-124, P&T Road, Near Shradhdha Library, Nehru Nagar, Kotra Sultanabad, Bhopal, MP 462003, India
- Short location: Nehru Nagar, Kotra Sultanabad, Bhopal (MP 462003)
- Google rating: 5.0 from 5 Google reviews

## Products & Services
- Signature chocolate hampers and gift boxes
- Custom celebration and wedding favors
- Corporate and bulk gifting (MOQ 15+ units or 10+ curated boxes)
- Studio pickup and local delivery in Bhopal, with temperature-safe shipping across Madhya Pradesh
